title: Log regular quotient after a tame equivariant modification
statement:
Let $C$ be an integral excellent separated Noetherian scheme, and let $B\subset C$ be a nowhere dense closed subset such that $(C,B)$ is a log regular pair. Let a finite group $G$ of order invertible on $C$ act on $C$, preserving $B$. Assume that the action is generically free, meaning free on geometric points over a $G$-stable dense open subset, and admissible, meaning every orbit lies in an affine open. Let $\pi:C\to X=C/G$ be the finite scheme quotient, with $X$ integral excellent Noetherian; the quotient has the orbit-space topology and structure sheaf $(\pi_*\mathcal O_C)^G$. There exist an integral excellent Noetherian scheme $M$, a proper birational morphism $\rho:M\to X$, and a nowhere dense closed subset $B_M\subset M$ such that $(M,B_M)$ is a log regular pair and $\rho^{-1}(\pi(B))\subseteq B_M$. Birational means inducing an isomorphism on dense open subschemes.

The notions are [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-exc-excellent-ring], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-trf-log-regular-pair], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Here separated means that the diagonal $C\to C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}C$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-pc-fibre-product].
